item.description: An art teacher at Hillcrest School who teaches middle and high school students with exceptional needs was named Marion County’s 2026 Teacher of the Year over the weekend. Read more: Special needs art instructor named Marion County 2026 Teacher of the Year

item.title: Edwin Cruz
item.description: Edwin Cruz's life was a testament to faith, love, sacrifice, and devotion to his family. His legacy will live on through the live he touched, the values he thought, and the love he gave so freely. Read more: Edwin Cruz

item.title: Ocala announces road closures for CSX railroad maintenance days after toxic fire in Dunnellon
item.description: The City of Ocala has announced that a portion of NE 9th Street will close later this week to accommodate railroad crossing maintenance by CSX, just days after the rail company faced scrutiny by Marion County officials over a massive fire involving chemically-coated railroad ties. Read more: Ocala announces road closures for CSX railroad maintenance days after toxic fire in Dunnellon

item.title: Eddie Farmer
item.description: Eddie Farmer was a pillar, dependable, protective, and deeply loving. Those closest to him knew that his love was shown through action: fixing, building, providing, and always being there when it mattered most. Read more: Eddie Farmer

item.title: Ocala mom who fears losing AIDS meds featured in Washington Post
item.description: An Ocala mother who was featured in The Washington Post says she fears losing access to affordable HIV medication, as the state moves to impose new income limits on access to funding for the drugs due to "rising health care insurance premiums" and a dearth in federal funding. Read more: Ocala mom who fears losing AIDS meds featured in Washington Post

item.title: The new high school in Ocala is impressive, but I believe it will strain local infrastructure
item.description: "The new high school is, in fact, an impressive structure. It sits about 1,000 feet south of our home in Summer Glen, and even closer to our back gate at Marion Oaks Manor. Construction has continued smoothly with little negative impact to our community. But, when it opens in August, the traffic around our community will be unsustainable.
